verdict.rationale: Navan documents a public developer API with OAuth 2.0 client credentials, retrieval and update endpoints across the expense surface, batch PATCH, pagination, field selection, custom-field management and async job polling. That lets a programmatic user drive the expense side of the product. However, the documented API surface is scoped to expenses, users and accounting config. There is no evidence of API access to travel booking or trip changes, and all evidence is vendor-claimed. missing for 10: documented API coverage of travel booking/trip management, published endpoint reference depth (schemas, rate limits), independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
